arena: [생존기] Anti-Magic Shell absorbs magic damage and blocks harmful magic effects for 5 sec. Use it when an enemy caster sends magic CC or magic burst.
[분담] With Spellwarden you can cast Anti-Magic Shell on allies and its cooldown drops by 10 sec. Put it on your healer when magic CC is incoming.
[생존기] Icebound Fortitude makes you immune to stuns and reduces all damage taken by 30% for 8 sec. Pop it right before the enemy stun chain starts.
[해제] Lichborne makes you immune to charm, fear and sleep for 10 sec. Pop it early when the enemy is about to fear.
[제어] Strangulate replaces Asphyxiate and silences a target up to 20 yds away for 4 sec. Put it on the enemy healer and burst with Pillar of Frost meanwhile.
[차단] Mind Freeze interrupts a cast from 15 yds and locks that school for 5 sec. Save it for the enemy healer's heals.
[제어] Blinding Sleet disorients enemies in front of you for 5 sec, then slows them by 50% for 6 sec, but damage can break it. Use it on enemy DPS your team isn't hitting.
[우선 처치] Death Grip pulls a target up to 30 yds away to you. Pull your kill target or the enemy healer out from behind a pillar into line of sight.
bg: [참고] Battleground Blitz groups run 5-6 DPS and healers carry the flag first. Death Grip the enemy flag carrier toward your team to help secure the kill.

[위치] Death's Advance increases movement speed by 35% for 10 sec, keeps slows from dropping you below normal speed, and grants knockback immunity. Pop it near edges or cart circles so you don't get knocked off.
[제어] Deathchill was picked by 25 of 46 Battleground Blitz players and adds a 4 sec root to Remorseless Winter and Chains of Ice. Hold the enemy flag carrier or stop enemies entering a base.
[생존기] Healing taken is reduced by 20% in battlegrounds. Rather than waiting on heals, use Icebound Fortitude and Anti-Magic Shell right before the burst.
[광역 피해] Frostwyrm's Fury damages all enemies in a 40 yd line, stuns for 3 sec and slows by 50% for 10 sec. Use it on enemies stacked on a base or cart.
[제어] Enemies disoriented by Blinding Sleet can't be knocked back. Use it on enemies trying to capture a base, but don't overlap it with your team's knockbacks.
pvpTalents: Strangulate, picked by 36 of the top 37 Solo Shuffle and 43 of 46 Battleground Blitz players, replaces Asphyxiate with a 4 sec silence. Spellwarden, picked by 30 of 37 Solo Shuffle and 31 of 46 Battleground Blitz players, lets you cast Anti-Magic Shell on allies. Deathchill, picked by 25 of 46 Battleground Blitz players, adds a 4 sec root to Remorseless Winter and Chains of Ice.

204080.d:
Your Remorseless Winter and Chains of Ice apply Deathchill, rooting the target in place for 4 sec.

Remorseless Winter
All targets within 8 yards are afflicted with Deathchill when Remorseless Winter is cast.

Chains of Ice
When you Chains of Ice a target already afflicted by your Chains of Ice they will be afflicted by Deathchill.
